_comment: The one-way TEST/TRAIN declaration for COURT clips, mirroring the rule the ball
side already enforces. Before this file existed, 17 of the 20 hand-labelled court
gold clips were also in data/court_dataset/ and train_courtnet.py had no leak
guard, so every number in data/gold/court_scores.md was the model being scored on
TEST clips are never trained on. Their .court.labels.json is a BENCHMARK.
TRAIN clips may also have .court.labels.json - those labels are TRAINING DATA and
must never be scored. tools/eval_court.py reads this file and scores TEST only.
This choice is ONE-WAY. Moving a clip from TEST to TRAIN destroys the benchmark;
moving one from TRAIN to TEST invalidates every checkpoint trained before the move.

test._why: 8 clips chosen for surface and camera diversity, not for what was left over.

clips.am_ntrp45_courtlevel: never trained on; court-level camera, the hardest mount
clips.am_wingfield_clay: pulled from training - the only clay clip; clay breaks white-line assumptions
clips.am_grass1: pulled from training - the only grass clip
clips.am_ntrp30: pulled from training - currently scores 0.0% detect; the failure case must be visible
clips.am_usta60: pulled from training - a second outdoor hard court at a different level

train._why: Everything else under data/court_dataset/. am_usta45final stays in TRAIN: it has only 3 labelled frames and is worthless as a test clip.
